stations.title: Dilys
stations.say: Can the opening hours stand out?

stations.title: Home page
stations.text: Only a body rule, so it all looks alike.

stations.title: Your styles
stations.gap: No way to pick one part

captions: Dilys wants the opening hours, and a few other parts, to stand out.
Every rule so far is for the whole body, so everything looks the same.
You pick parts with grouped names, a class, an id and links inside the nav.
The opening hours sit on sand, and visitors see them first.
Same stylesheet, new rules. Now each part of the page can have its own look.
